# Jac-It House Leveling & Foundation Repair

> Providing dependable foundation repair and house leveling services across Deep East Texas for over 25 years.

## About Us
Jac-It House Leveling & Foundation Repair is a professional service providing foundation solutions in the Deep East Texas region. With over 25 years of experience, we specialize in repairing and securing properties with lasting results. We are a BBB Accredited Business.

## Services
- Pier & Beam Repair
- Foundation Repair
- House Leveling
- Press Piers
- Slab Repair
- Foam Injection
- Drainage Solutions

## Service Areas
We serve the Deep East Texas region. See [all service areas](/locations) for an overview, or use the city pages below — each covers local soil conditions, common foundation problems, and the communities we cover nearby:
- [Tyler, TX](/locations/tyler) - Smith County
- [Lufkin, TX](/locations/lufkin) - Angelina County
- [Longview, TX](/locations/longview) - Gregg County
- [Livingston, TX](/locations/livingston) - Polk County
- [Henderson, TX](/locations/henderson) - Rusk County
- [Nacogdoches, TX](/locations/nacogdoches) - Nacogdoches County
- [Huntsville, TX](/locations/huntsville) - Walker County
- And surrounding communities
